title: Type 2 diabetes predicted effector genes - Integrated Classifier method (Majarian T and Manning A 2020)
bodyHtml:
This table displays results from an unpublished study (Majarian T and Manning A, 2020).

The Integrated Classifier method integrates functional and semantic data to predict effector genes for type 2 diabetes. Click the Research Method tab for more details on the method.

The T2D effector prediction summary page compares these results with type 2 diabetes effector gene predictions generated by two other methods.
